card.ch1.label: Chapter 1
card.ch1.title: Read Before Use
end.ch1.title: End of Chapter 1
end.ch1.body:
The door is gone, but the manual still has plenty of pages.
And someone, apparently, is correcting them.
rule.extract: Removing items from the manual is {}.
page.p1.title: Getting Started
page.p1.intro: Thank you for choosing GRAND ADVENTURE DELUXE! To begin your adventure, press the START button shown below.
page.p1.note: Should the button fail to appear on screen, please consult the manual. This manual. This page.
page.p1.margin: why draw it if it isn't there?
page.p2.title: What's in the Box
page.p2.intro: Your copy of GRAND ADVENTURE DELUXE contains:
page.p2.note: If something is missing, that's not our problem.
page.p2.margin: did the key end up here by mistake? — M.
page.p3.title: Warnings
page.p3.fine: The manufacturer accepts no liability for doors opened without authorization.
page.p3.margin: these words are glued on really badly...
page.p4.title: Contents
page.p4.index:
Getting Started ............ 1
What's in the Box ............ 2
Warnings ............ 3
How to Cross the Bridge ............ 7
Chapter 4 ............ (does not exist)
Last Page ............ ?
n.welcome1: Welcome to GRAND ADVENTURE DELUXE! Before playing, please read the manual carefully.
n.welcome3: ...Kidding. Nobody reads the manual. Press START and let's go.
n.nostart1: That's the START button. Press it.
n.nostart2: I know it looks like an empty rectangle. It's a very minimalist START button.
n.nostart3: Okay, maybe the button didn't... load. It happens. No need to open the manual. Really.
n.startplaced1: There! See? The START button. It was there all along.
n.startplaced2: ...Why is it blue? And why does it look drawn in ballpoint pen?
n.collapse1: NO NO NO! That was the title screen! It took me an hour to center it!
n.collapse2: Fine. Moving on. Let's pretend that was all part of the plan.
n.logo1: GRAND ADVENTURE DELUXE. The title says it all. Especially the "DELUXE" part.
n.logo2: Don't touch the logo. It was very expensive. I think.
n.typo_tagline: "Anticipatted"? Who wrote "anticipatted"? Pretend you didn't see that.
n.typo_poster: "Rooom." Three O's. It's a big room. Spacious.
n.typo_done: Yes, yes, you already found that one. Stop rubbing it in.
n.tempty1: There's nothing there. The START button is in the middle. The rectangle. That one.
n.tempty2: Tapping the screen at random isn't a strategy. It's a habit.
n.dropwrong1: And what exactly is that supposed to do?
n.room1: Behold: the Starting Room. Tastefully furnished, on a budget.
n.room2: To open this door, you need a key.
n.room3: The key is right here, in this room. Take your time. I have all the time in the world.
n.door1: Locked. You need a key. I literally just told you.
n.door2: Knocking won't help. I know, because I wrote it: knocking won't help.
n.door3: Stare all you like, it stays shut. Two can play the stubborn game.
n.rempty2: Not there either. Odd. It was in the script.
n.rempty3: Okay, maybe the key isn't exactly "in the room". But don't go looking for it in the manual. For any reason.
n.rempty4: Keep looking. It's good for your circulation.
n.plant1: The plant is decorative. It contains no puzzles. Don't touch it.
n.plant4: It's not speaking to you anymore. Congratulations, you offended the furniture.
n.window1: Out there is the rest of the game. Not loaded yet. Don't stare at it.
n.window2: That sky is a background image. Convincing, isn't it?
n.stop1: STOP! YOU CAN'T TAKE THINGS OUT OF THE MANUAL!
n.stop2: They're FOR ILLUSTRATIVE PURPOSES ONLY! It says so! ...It'll say so. Somewhere.
n.stop3: There. Page 3. It used to be blank. Now it says so. That'll teach you.
n.stop4: The key goes back where it belongs. And you go back to looking for the real one. Which is in the room. Probably.
n.locked1: Ah-ah. Page 3: removing items from the manual is FORBIDDEN. You did read it, right?
n.locked2: F-O-R-B-I-D-D-E-N. Want me to draw you a picture? Actually, no pictures. You'd only steal them.
n.locked3: Rules are rules. They're written down. And what's written never changes. Ever.
n.rx_allowed1: Hey! Did you just MOVE a word? Words don't move! That's not how reading works!
n.rx_allowed2: Put it back right now. I'm not looking.
n.rx_notincluded: "Removing items is NOT INCLUDED." That doesn't even mean anything. So, to be safe, it's still forbidden.
n.rx_seated: "Playing while seated is FORBIDDEN." Wonderful. You're playing standing up from now on. Happy?
n.rx_batteries: Batteries FORBIDDEN. Fine, this game runs on pages anyway.
n.rx_back: Good. Everything back where it was. Order is the foundation of every adventure.
n.allowed1: Hold on. "Removing items from the manual is RECOMMENDED"? So... technically... it's allowed.
n.allowed3: ...Fine. FINE. Go on in. There's nothing interesting back there anyway.
n.who1: And who are you supposed to be? You're not in the manual. I know the whole manual. Most of it.
c.2: Door opened without a key. Not in the approved text. Typo.
c.3: Corrected. It's nothing personal. It's grammatical.
n.after1: ...It erased the door. It erased MY door.
n.after2: Okay, no panicking. Every game has its little... holes.
n.after3: You close the manual. I'm going to check that page 7 is still where it should be.
n.hole: A door-shaped hole. Very artistic. Very useless.
n.jealous1: You're asking a PENCIL for help? I am the NARRATOR!
n.jealous2: ...Who wrote that? Who's in the margin?
h.start.1: Psst. Yes, that rectangle is empty. But somewhere a START button does exist. Drawn.
h.start.2: Technically, the manual isn't just for reading. Page 1: that button looks a bit... detachable.
h.start.3: Open the manual, drag the START button from page 1 into the dashed rectangle, then tap it.
h.key.1: The narrator says the key is in the room. The narrator says a lot of things.
h.key.2: Page 2: "What's in the Box". What's in the box, exactly?
h.key.3: Drag the key from page 2 of the manual onto the door.
h.rule.1: The rules are on page 3. But who said rules can't be rewritten?
h.rule.2: Some words on page 3 are crooked, like they were glued on badly. Crooked words come loose.
h.rule.3: Drag RECOMMENDED onto FORBIDDEN: they swap places. Then take the key to the door again.
h.none: I've got no ideas right now. Weird. Usually I have too many.
